about_short_description.short_description: Panther is a modern SIEM platform that solves the challenges of security operations at scale

product.name: Panther AI SOC Platform
product.description: A cloud-scale security operations platform that centralizes security data, detection engineering, alert triage, investigation, threat hunting, and response using Python-based detections and AI-assisted workflows.

product.name: Panther SaaS
product.description: A fully managed deployment of the Panther platform in Panther’s cloud environment, providing managed infrastructure for security data ingestion, detection, investigation, and response.

product.name: Cloud Connected
product.description: A customer-controlled deployment of Panther installed in the customer’s AWS environment and connected to its Snowflake or Databricks data lake, preserving customer control of security data and infrastructure.

product.name: Professional Services
product.description: Onboarding, implementation, and project-based services that help customers deploy, configure, and extend the Panther platform.

product.name: Support Services
product.description: Informational and technical assistance for customers using the Panther platform, provided during the subscription term under Panther’s support terms.
